summary: The agent implemented a correct, large speedup optimization, but the verifier recorded an empty patch due to a harness git failure and never graded the work.
concern: Separate-verifier patch capture in task/tests/test.sh appears broken for this rollout: it selected /logs/artifacts/testbed, git rejected the repo (fatal: not a git repository) and failed on `git diff --cached`, yielding a 0-byte patch and empty_patch scoring even though the agent left a multi-kilobyte diff in its workspace at session end. The harness should either preserve a valid .git in transferred artifacts or fall back to a non-git file diff when git operations fail.

verdict.outcome_rationale: This is a spurious verifier failure: the agent genuinely solved the optimization task, but grading never saw its patch. The verifier reported binary_reward 0 with reward 0.0 after capturing a 0-byte patch and exiting early with empty_patch status [1][2], so it never ran the 13-test speedup/equivalence harness or the >1.20 continuous threshold [3]. The instruction required optimizing the HuggingFace datasets benchmark while preserving identical outputs and reinstalling after source edits [4]. Before patching, the agent profiled the hot path and found ~0.25s per experiment dominated by column gathering after select materialized an indices mapping [5]. It then added a contiguous large-range fast path in Dataset.select (zero-copy slicing via `_MIN_CONTIGUOUS_SELECT_FAST_PATH_SIZE` and helper validators) plus faster null-free primitive column extraction in formatting, leaving a ~5 KB diff across `arrow_dataset.py` and `formatting.py` [6]. After reinstalling editable, repeated runs dropped to ~0.003–0.005s with median 0.00343s while preserving `total_value = 49823.66508803339` and the full result dict [7][8], far above the 1.20× pass bar [3]. At session end `git status` still showed both source files modified with the same diff content [6][9]. The failure is therefore not missing optimization work but broken patch capture: test.sh targeted `/logs/artifacts/testbed`, git errored with “not a git repository” and unsupported `--cached`, and emitted “Patch size: 0 bytes” without evaluating the agent’s actual changes [2]. That makes this FN—the agent accomplished the task, but the separate-verifier artifact/git pipeline spuriously scored it as an empty submission.
